[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew this '''[[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]]''' during the late [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
===Outer Rim Sieges===
{{Quote|A little toasted, but I'm okay.|Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Battle of Belderone|<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
The fighter was assigned to Kenobi shortly after his use of a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|previous interceptor]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. With his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] now ready for use with a fighter of this class, Kenobi transferred to the newer, red-hulled fighter.

A [[Battle of Belderone|vicious fight]] over [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] would see the [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] in use against the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid fighters]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. Although it sustained damage during the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|battle]],<ref name="LOE" /> it was still in combat condition at the fight's conclusion.

During a [[Recapture of Tythe|mission]] against CIS leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] some weeks later, Kenobi piloted the interceptor to [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]], where it formed part of a taskforce to assault the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

===Coruscant and destruction===
{{Quote|Flying's for droids!|Kenobi during combat over Coruscant|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
Responding to a call from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] reporting that the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] had been kidnapped by [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid leader]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], Kenobi and his comrade [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] proceeded to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] to mount a rescue.

[[File:ROTS-RacingthroughCoruscant.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker and Kenobi race towards Grievous's flagship aboard their Eta-2s]]
Arriving insystem, Kenobi used the interceptor to impressive extent during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battle]]. Although formidable against droid fighters and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|tri-fighters]], the ship was assaulted by [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]]. The droids wreaked havoc on the interceptor, destroying Kenobi's droid R4-P17 and ruining its systems.

Although Anakin Skywalker was able to help guide Kenobi to a safe landing inside [[Invisible Hand/Legends|Grievous's cruiser]], the ship was unfit for action, having had its left wing foils completely sheared off. As the cruiser took fire from Republic [[Starship/Legends|warships]], it was cleaved in two, and the hangar was destroyed; with it, Kenobi's interceptor.
